name: Iowa

context: IA 340: cover crops can cut wind and water erosion; plan canopy plus residue cover of 90 percent or more during erosive periods.
cover_rules: IA 340: plant the cover crop as early as possible and terminate it as late as practical.
IA 340: winter cereal rye, winter triticale and camelina may be seeded late, prior to December 21, with drilling advised.
residue: IA 329: maintain a minimum of 60 percent residue cover on the soil surface throughout the year; do not shred residue.
IA 329: stubble at least 10 inches for rows under 15 inches apart, at least 15 inches for rows of 15 inches or more.
barriers: IA 585: include a minimum of two strips within the area prone to wind erosion.
IA 386: place field borders as stable stiff-stemmed upright grass on the windward edge of the field.
windbreak: IA 380: field windbreak needs a minimum of 2 rows; the best protection is 2 to 5 times the tallest row height (H) downwind, extending to 10H.
grazing: IA 528: Short graze periods of 5 days or less with longer rest periods (45 to 365 days) improve the health and vigor of plant communities.
drought: IA 528: Plan periodic deferment from grazing following severe drought to restore the desired plant community.
IA 528: Keep a contingency plan for severe drought to adjust the grazing prescription.
seeding: IA 342: for spring seedings of introduced species, seed oats or a spring cereal grain at 1 1/2 bushels/acre to cut erosion; clip at seed head emergence.
IA 342: native grass seeding rates are in PLS pounds/acre.
IA 484: when mulching with straw or grass hay, apply enough for a minimum 70 percent ground cover.
dont_seed: IA 342: late summer seeding of native species is not recommended in the seeding date table.
IA 512: native species late summer seeding is not allowed.
pasture: IA 512: pick plants that give maximum ground cover to protect the soil from wind and water erosion.
disturbed: IA 342: sand sites with deep or coarse sands, droughty, use Switchgrass 5 and Prairie sandreed grass 4.
dunes: IA 342: dune plants must survive burial by blowing sand and sandblasting; use sand fences or brush matting.

coverPlant.text: IA 340: spring seeding in mid to late March for non winter hardy covers; allow a minimum of 5 weeks of growth after emergence.

seedWin.text: IA 342: native species spring seeding April 1 - July 1, dormant seeding November 15 - Freeze, frost seeding February 1 - March 15.
